heading: ### "Build fails with checksum mismatch error"
proposed: With this layout every `./judo.sh build` formats the generated frontend code after writing it (`pnpm run format`, Biome), so the generated files never match their checksums. Use `./judo.sh build -i` for every build; without `-i` each generated file of `src/` is reported as manually changed. `-i` leaves `.generated-files` of the frontend module empty, so the checksum protection cannot be turned on later without regenerating `src/`.

heading: #### In TransferObjectType (unmapped)
proposed: An actor reaches a static operation on an unmapped transfer object through a derived access on the actor whose target is a mapped transfer object: map a transfer object to a row of the model (for example a settings entity with no members), declare the STATIC operation on that transfer object, and add a DERIVED 0..1 access on the actor to that row (for example `<Entity>!any()`). The access target must be mapped; the row must exist at runtime, otherwise the access is empty. The REST route is `POST /api/<app>/<Actor>/<TransferObject>/<operation>` with the input as the JSON body; a fault returns 422 with `X-Fault`. A void static operation is possible.

heading: ### Practice notes: a fragment for `application_default.json`
proposed: The fragment is included at the top of the generated `application_default.json`. A key that the generator writes later in the same object (for example `enumerations.<Enum>.<MEMBER>`) overrides a duplicate key from the fragment, so an override of a generated key has no effect. An enumeration member has no label in the model, so a readable label needs a key that the generator does not write, or the model name is shown.

heading: #### Pattern 4: Partial Updates
proposed: To send a partial update that keeps the version check, put the identifier and the version into the payload with the generated builder: `<Entity>Builder.from(Map.of("__identifier", <identifier>, "__entityType", "<Entity>", "__version", <version>, "<attribute>", <value>)).build()`. A `__version` in the payload makes the optimistic-lock check apply to the update; the mask only shapes the returned entity.

heading: ### Placement
proposed: In the horizontal top bar the navigation takes `8 - spaceRequired` of the 12 grid columns and the right side takes `2 + spaceRequired`; the default `spaceRequired` is 1. The scroll arrows of the menu reserve space too. A top bar with five or more menu groups plus search, switches, cart and profile needs a larger `spaceRequired` and a compact extra component (for example no wrapping, narrow profile name, icon-only search); at 1280px the last menu group can sit behind a scroll arrow.
